ctx.x: Okay, well and also you can make assumptions about, if we’re talking about musicians, where you’re going to be more likely to play in a certain way.

Oh yeah. Oh that’s true. But these days that’s usually not the case because there’s such diversity of styles within the music that it’s hard to just look at someone and say well they play such-and-such a style. That’s hard these days I’d say. But getting back to what I was saying about race and culture, so race itself as a biological reality is an illusion you know. But because race has become a part of the way people look at things, the way some people look at things and the way people then behave towards…

didn’t allow me to make that leap was the music. Because I loved Phil Woods and his playing. Because I loved Paul Desmond. I loved Zoot Sims. And that was like a shield that protected me against falling prey to that kind of thinking, man.
